questions.q: Why is Solidity described as a "contract-oriented" language?
options: It has nothing to do with smart contracts
Its entire design centers on writing and deploying smart contracts
It can only write legal contracts, not code
It was the first language ever created
questions.explain: Solidity is high-level and specifically designed around the task of writing and deploying smart contracts on Ethereum.

questions.q: In the car-driving analogy from this lesson, what does a low-level language like assembly or C represent?
options: Driving with a steering wheel and pedals
A language with no real-world equivalent
Not driving at all
Building and tuning the engine yourself — full control, harder, more efficient
questions.explain: Low-level languages give you full, direct control over the machine — like manually adjusting pistons, spark plugs, and fuel flow — at the cost of more complexity.

questions.q: What do all programming languages ultimately reduce to, at the lowest level a computer understands?
options: JSON
English words
Binary — ones and zeros
Solidity bytecode only
questions.explain: Every language, no matter how high-level, is eventually converted down to binary — the only thing a computer's hardware actually understands.

questions.q: Which of these languages is named in this lesson as a real influence on Solidity's design?
options: Assembly only, with no other influences
JavaScript
COBOL
Fortran
questions.explain: The lesson names JavaScript, Python, and C++ as the languages that influenced Solidity's design.

questions.q: What's the real trade-off you make by choosing a high-level language over a low-level one?
options: There is no trade-off at all
You gain more control over CPU registers
High-level languages always run faster than low-level ones
You sacrifice some direct control for convenience and faster development
questions.explain: High-level languages are easier to use and closer to human language, but you give up some of the fine-grained control over memory and CPU details that low-level languages provide.
